rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Radar contact! The Gaizock are coming!
rows.display_text: 「Radar contact! The Gaizock are coming!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: All units, prepare to intercept!
rows.display_text: 「All units, prepare to intercept!」

rows.speaker: Uchuta
rows.en: Butcher's not here...!
rows.display_text: 「Butcher's not here...!」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Looks like the Bandock is standing by in the rear!
rows.display_text:
「Looks like the Bandock is standing by
in the rear!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: That bastard! Watching from a safe distance in the back, huh!
rows.display_text:
「That bastard! Watching from a safe
distance in the back, huh!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Then all we have to do is smash through them and drag him out!
rows.display_text:
「Then all we have to do is smash
through them and drag him out!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: But if the fight drags on, we're the ones at a disadvantage...
rows.display_text:
「But if the fight drags on, we're the
ones at a disadvantage...」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: We'll settle this in these five minutes...!
rows.display_text:
「We'll settle this in these five
minutes...!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: All units! Clear out the enemies in front of us and drag the Bandock out!
rows.display_text:
「All units! Clear out the enemies in
front of us and drag the Bandock out!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: And once the Bandock shows itself, we bring it down in a single blow!
rows.display_text:
「And once the Bandock shows itself, we
bring it down in a single blow!」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: The Bandock's predicted appearance point is right here!
rows.display_text:
「The Bandock's predicted appearance
point is right here!」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Wipe out the Mechaboost army, then take down the Gaizock in one blow...
rows.display_text:
「Wipe out the Mechaboost army, then
take down the Gaizock in one blow...」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: And we have to do all of that within five minutes.
rows.display_text:
「And we have to do all of that within
five minutes.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: No time to waste getting scared! Let's charge in!
rows.display_text:
「No time to waste getting scared! Let's
charge in!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Just wait, Butcher! I'll drag you out here for sure!
rows.display_text:
「Just wait, Butcher! I'll drag you out
here for sure!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Here I come, Mechaboost! First I'll crush the lot of you!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, Mechaboost! First I'll
crush the lot of you!」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: All right! The Mechaboost are down!
rows.display_text: 「All right! The Mechaboost are down!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: A bit early to celebrate, Kiraken...! Here comes the big boss!
rows.display_text:
「A bit early to celebrate, Kiraken...!
Here comes the big boss!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Ho ho ho ho ho! Wiping out my whole Mechaboost army -- you Earthlings aren't half bad.
rows.display_text:
「Ho ho ho ho ho! Wiping out my whole
Mechaboost army -- you Earthlings aren't
half bad.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: As a reward, I, Killer the Butcher, shall face you myself.
rows.display_text:
「As a reward, I, Killer the Butcher, shall
face you myself.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: You bastard! That laugh of yours ends right here!
rows.display_text:
「You bastard! That laugh of yours ends
right here!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Butcher! Today's the day you die!!
rows.display_text: 「Butcher! Today's the day you die!!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: We only get one chance! Pour every bit of strength we have into the Bandock!
rows.display_text:
「We only get one chance! Pour every bit
of strength we have into the Bandock!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Here I come, Butcher! All the rage of the people you've tormented -- we're unleashing it on you!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, Butcher! All the rage of
the people you've tormented -- we're
unleashing it on you!!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: T-that's absurd!! Gwaaaaaaahhh!!
rows.display_text: 「T-that's absurd!! Gwaaaaaaahhh!!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: We did it! Have you learned your lesson, Gaizock!
rows.display_text:
「We did it! Have you learned your lesson,
Gaizock!」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Amazing. Dealing {tm} damage in a single blow...
rows.display_text:
「Amazing. Dealing {tm} damage in a
single blow...」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: By my calculations, the max damage dealt exceeds 56,000.
rows.display_text:
「By my calculations, the max damage
dealt exceeds 56,000.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: So we managed to hit close to the max, huh.
rows.display_text:
「So we managed to hit close to the max,
huh.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: But this doesn't mean every enemy targeting Earth has been wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「But this doesn't mean every enemy
targeting Earth has been wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: I know that, Pop.
rows.display_text: 「I know that, Pop.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: No matter who comes at us, as long as we're here, we won't let them have their way.
rows.display_text:
「No matter who comes at us, as long as
we're here, we won't let them have their
way.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: Because that's the fight that's ours to fight.
rows.display_text:
「Because that's the fight that's ours to
fight.」

rows.speaker: Uchuta
rows.en: So the damage dealt was {tm}. Not bad at all.
rows.display_text:
「So the damage dealt was {tm}. Not
bad at all.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: But by my calculations, the max damage dealt exceeds 56,000.
rows.display_text:
「But by my calculations, the max damage
dealt exceeds 56,000.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: We won and he's still being harsh -- that's Julie for you.
rows.display_text:
「We won and he's still being harsh --
that's Julie for you.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Come on, it's fine. Let's just enjoy the win for now.
rows.display_text:
「Come on, it's fine. Let's just enjoy the
win for now.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: No matter who comes at us, as long as we're here, we won't let them have their way.
rows.display_text:
「No matter who comes at us, as long as
we're here, we won't let them have their
way.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: You Earthlings, pulling off such an outrageous stunt!
rows.display_text:
「You Earthlings, pulling off such an
outrageous stunt!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: I'm in a foul mood! We're heading home for today!
rows.display_text:
「I'm in a foul mood! We're heading home
for today!」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: The Bandock is falling back!
rows.display_text: 「The Bandock is falling back!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: So the operation failed... Back to square one, then.
rows.display_text:
「So the operation failed... Back to
square one, then.」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Five minutes of operation time have passed! Our forces' attrition is about to exceed the limit!
rows.display_text:
「Five minutes of operation time have
passed! Our forces' attrition is about to
exceed the limit!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: There's nothing left to do but retreat here...!
rows.display_text:
「There's nothing left to do but retreat
here...!」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Grandpa! We've picked up movement from the Gaizock!
rows.display_text:
「Grandpa! We've picked up movement from
the Gaizock!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: If we leave them running loose any longer, the damage will only keep spreading.
rows.display_text:
「If we leave them running loose any
longer, the damage will only keep
spreading.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: To all hands! The King Beal is now committing everything it has to a decisive battle against the Gaizock!
rows.display_text:
「To all hands! The King Beal is now
committing everything it has to a decisive
battle against the Gaizock!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: All right! Let's show them what we've got!
rows.display_text:
「All right! Let's show them what we've
got!」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: But the Bandock, the Gaizock's mothership, is a formidable enemy.
rows.display_text:
「But the Bandock, the Gaizock's
mothership, is a formidable enemy.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: And on top of that, that Butcher guy fights like it's half a game.
rows.display_text:
「And on top of that, that Butcher guy
fights like it's half a game.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: If he's ever in real trouble, he'll probably turn tail and run right away.
rows.display_text:
「If he's ever in real trouble, he'll
probably turn tail and run right away.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Then let's settle this in one shot before he can run.
rows.display_text:
「Then let's settle this in one shot
before he can run.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: We'll pour everything we have into a single strike and bring down the Bandock.
rows.display_text:
「We'll pour everything we have into a
single strike and bring down the Bandock.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: All right! Let's give that bastard a hit that'll make his eyes pop out!
rows.display_text:
「All right! Let's give that bastard a hit
that'll make his eyes pop out!」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Just you wait, Killer the Butcher! We'll make you feel the full weight of our anger!
rows.display_text:
「Just you wait, Killer the Butcher! We'll
make you feel the full weight of our
anger!」
